title: Two-agent incident router with memory, carousel and review card
request: Build TWO agents. 'oncall' holds the schedule: payments -> maria, search -> dev, auth -> kim. 'router' is the entry agent: for 'incident: <service> <severity>' (severity sev1, sev2 or sev3) it asks oncall who is on call, records an incident for that user with id INC-<n> (n counts from 1 per user), and replies 'Paged <person> for <service> (<severity>)'. For sev1 it also attaches a review card titled 'Escalate to manager?' with an Approve button (selection {"action":"escalate","incident":"INC-<n>"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"dismiss"}); sev2/sev3 replies have no card. On the escalate selection reply '<incident> escalated'. 'incidents' replies '<k> open incidents' with a carousel card, one item per incident (title = id, subtitle = '<service> <severity>'). Unknown service: 'No on-call for <service>'.
